styleAnchor: STYLE ANCHOR [kilnspire v1.0.0]: Kilnspire, a towering molten-glass forge where living fire is blown into radiant star-glass. Mood: epic, incandescent, masterful craft. Shape language: rounded luminous glass volumes over angular brass armatures on black basalt. Materials: molten glass, aged brass, black basalt. Lighting: warm key from lower-left furnace glow, cool teal rim from upper-right skylight vent. Symbols orthographic front-on; environments share a horizon at 42% height. Painterly 2.5D game art, crisp edges, controlled bloom, no photorealism.
paletteLock: PALETTE LOCK: bg-deep #120A0F, bg-mid #2A1520, playfield #3A1E24, molten #FF7A2F, glass-hot #FFC96B, glass-cool #7FD8D4, brass #C98A2D, basalt #23252B, win #FFD75E, action #E4572E. Use ONLY these hues plus neutral shades derived from them; no off-palette colours. Magenta/hot-pink is banned from all art (it is the keying colour).
negativeBase: photorealism, watermark, signature, readable text, text artifacts, off-palette colours, existing slot-game lookalikes, protected characters or logos, celebrity likeness, magenta or hot-pink pigment, soft feathered glow halo, drop shadow, border
